prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original square black-and-white technical line illustration for a custodial-training atlas.

The two inputs are project-owned generic drawings, not manufacturer products. Image 1 is the accepted full-tool topology reference. Image 2 is a passed close-up that clarifies the adjustment mechanism. Create a new in-use composition rather than copying either image's angle or framing.

Non-negotiable mechanism: preserve exactly the same single adjustment system shown by the inputs. The curved movable hook jaw is the top end of one straight rectangular threaded shank. That same one-piece shank passes through exactly one plain knurled adjustment nut at the body. There is no other screw or threaded member. Do not invent a separate inner threaded rod, a second shank, a loop below the nut, a return bend, U-shape, fork, second rack, second rail, second nut, or worm gear. The lower fixed heel jaw is integral to the body and has no moving rack.

In-use transformation: show exactly one short round cylindrical steel pipe coupling running almost horizontally across the upper third of the canvas. Seat it inside the open jaws. Make the hook-jaw serrations visibly touch the top of the cylinder and the fixed-heel serrations visibly touch its underside. Both tangent contact points must be unobstructed, outside the body silhouette, and unmistakable at 320 by 320, with no gap and no teeth penetrating through the metal. Establish roundness with one restrained elliptical end rim or circumferential band; never make the fitting hexagonal.

New composition: turn the tool into a near-side working profile with the complete handle descending almost vertically and leaning slightly left. Enlarge the head and pipe contact while retaining the full handle and even white padding. Redesign the handle as a plain solid forged bar with a softly rounded solid end. No inset panel, recess, groove, channel, cutout, round hole, oblong hole, or decorative contour.

Style: original monochrome educational line art on opaque pure white; crisp black contours, medium interior lines, sparse functional hatching, minimal pale-gray form wash. Exactly one wrench and one fitting. No hands, people, cheater bar, hammer, arrows, motion marks, labels, text, pseudo-text, numerals, branding, logo, watermark, color, floor, room, bench, border, cast shadow, photorealism, glossy product rendering, duplicate parts, detached parts, or copied trade dress.
